# `r section_title`

## Recordings

```{r, fig.height = 3.2}
plot_recordings_day(g)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
problems <- table(g$problem[!g$valid])
pending <- sum(g$valid & !g$analysed)
if (length(problems) || pending) {
  paragraph(int(sum(problems) + pending), " of ", int(nrow(g)), " recordings were not analysed:")
  kable_md(data.frame(Reason = c(names(problems), if (pending) "valid, but not analysed by BirdNET"),
                      Recordings = c(as.integer(problems), if (pending) pending)))
} else {
  paragraph("All the recordings are valid and were analysed.")
}
if (any(g$triggered %in% TRUE)) {
  paragraph(int(sum(g$triggered %in% TRUE)), " recordings were triggered by an amplitude or frequency threshold; their silences were restored before the analysis.")
}
vars <- battery_variables(g)
if (length(vars)) {
  paragraph(if (length(vars) == 2) "Battery voltage and temperature" else if (vars == "battery_v") "Battery voltage" else "Temperature",
            " recorded by the AudioMoth at the start of each recording:")
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 2.8, eval = length(battery_variables(g)) > 0}
plot_battery(g)
```

## Detected species

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (!analysed) {
  paragraph("**Not analysed with BirdNET.**")
} else if (nrow(r)) {
  paragraph(nrow(r), " species with at least one detection of confidence ≥ ", num(data$min_confidence),
            ", sorted by number of detections. *No doubts*: share of detections in which BirdNET proposed no other species in the same 3 s window.")
  table_species(r, several_recorders = length(unique(g$recorder)) > 1)
} else {
  paragraph("There are no detections with confidence ≥ ", num(data$min_confidence), ".")
}
```

```{r, fig.height = height_confidence, eval = nrow(r) > 0}
plot_confidence(d, r)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = nrow(r) > 25}
paragraph("The plot shows the 25 most frequent species.")
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = nrow(r) > 0 && length(unique(g$recorder)) > 1}
cat("### Detections by recorder\n\n")
matrix_recorders(d, r)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = nrow(r) > 0}
cat("## Activity\n\n")
paragraph("Detections and number of species per day:")
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.2, eval = nrow(r) > 0}

```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = nrow(r) > 0}

```


## Examples

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(ex)) {
  paragraph("Spectrograms of the examples extracted with `extract_examples()`. The dashed lines mark the 3 s window of the detection; the audio and video of each example are in the `examples/` folder of the results.")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ex))) {
    who <- if (length(unique(ex$recorder)) > 1 || several) paste0(esc(ex$recorder[i]), " · ") else ""
    cat(sprintf("![%s%s (%s), confidence %s, %s %s](%s){width=85%%}\n\n", who, esc(ex$common_name[i]),
                italic(ex$scientific_name[i]), num(ex$confidence[i]), date_txt(ex$local_date[i]),
                ex$local_time[i], ex$png[i]))
  }
} else {
  paragraph("No examples have been extracted. Use `detected_species()` to choose species and `extract_examples()` to create them.")
}
```

## Records for Observation.org

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(obs)) {
  certain <- sum(obs$`is certain` == "True")
  paragraph(nrow(obs), " records (one per species and day) in the import file",
            if (certain) paste0("; ", certain, " validated by ear (`is certain = True`)") else "",
            if (certain < nrow(obs)) paste0(". The ", nrow(obs) - certain, " not validated are marked as uncertain (`is certain = False`) and should be checked before uploading them") else "",
            ".")
  t <- data.frame(Date = date_txt(obs$date), Time = obs$time, Species = italic(obs$`scientific name`),
                  Certain = obs$`is certain`, Recorder = esc(obs$recorder), check.names = FALSE)
  if (length(unique(obs$recorder)) == 1) t$Recorder <- NULL
  kable_md(t)
} else {
  paragraph("No records have been exported to Observation.org with `export_observation()`.")
}
```
